preconditions.description: The input integer n must be between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' and len(output_lines) == n and all(1 <= int(line) <= n for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: If a valid sequence exists, output 'YES' followed by n lines containing distinct integers from 1 to n.
If no valid sequence exists, output 'NO'.
